SELECT t1.TR_YMD,t1.TR_CD,t1.BALH_CO,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,jb.BALH_NM,NULL,NULL,NULL, t1.JM_CD,t1.SJ_KOSCOM_CD,t1.SJ_JM_CD,j1.JJ_NM JM_NM,j2.JJ_NM KOSCOM_NM, t1.CLOSE_YMD,t1.HWAKJ_YMD,t1.KRAK_YMD,t1.BAEJ_GIJUN_YMD,t1.CHENG_YMD,t1.BALH_GA,t1.HWAKJ_BALH_GA, CASE WHEN t1.TR_YMD >= #{workDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END P_VISIBLE FROM SJT0JL t1 LEFT JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.BALH_CO=t1.BALH_CO LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ j1 ON j1.JM_CD=t1.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ j2 ON j2.JM_CD=t1.SJ_JM_CD WHERE t1.TR_CD='G55'
SELECT t1.TR_YMD,t1.TR_CD,t1.BALH_CO,t1.OLD_JM_CD,t1.OLD_DANC_GB,t1.OLD_KOSCOM_CD,t1.NEW_JM_CD,t1.NEW_DANC_GB,t1.NEW_KOSCOM_CD, jb.BALH_NM,j1.JJ_FNM OLD_JM_NM,j2.JJ_FNM NEW_JM_NM,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, t1.JONGA,CASE WHEN t1.TR_CD='G00' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END G00, CASE WHEN t1.TR_YMD >= #{workDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END P_VISIBLE FROM SJT0SK t1 LEFT JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.BALH_CO=t1.BALH_CO LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ j1 ON j1.JM_CD=t1.OLD_JM_CD LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ j2 ON j2.JM_CD=t1.NEW_JM_CD WHERE t1.TR_CD IN ('G00','G51','G53')t1.TR_CD='G54't1.TR_CD='G53'
ORDER BY TR_YMD DESC,BALH_CO

SELECT /*+ FULL (SZX0AA) INDEX (SJM0JM SJM0JM_IDX) */ t1.CORP_GR, aa.COMPANY_NAME, t1.FUND_CD, ia.FUND_NM, t1.BS_TYPE, NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.UP_JUSU,0) - NVL(t1.DW_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) AS JUSU, NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.UP_CHUI_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.DW_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_CHUI_AEK,0) AS AEK, t1.GONGS_DW_JUSU, t1.GONGS_DW_CHUI_AEK FROM SZX0AA aa, SJM0JM t1, SZM0IA ia WHERE aa.CORP_GR LIKE #{corpGr} AND t1.CORP_GR = aa.CORP_GR AND t1.YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND NVL(t1.BFIL_BOYU_JUSU,0) + NVL(t1.GONGS_UP_JUSU,0) > 0 AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND NVL(ia.HAEJI_YMD, TO_DATE(#{ymd},'yyyymmdd') + 1) > TO_DATE(#{ymd},'yyyymmdd') ORDER BY 8, t1.CORP_GR, t1.FUND_CD, t1.BS_TYPE
